faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for LDCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for LDCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application for Registration form attached to the notice (page 2)) and send it to LDCL, Kochi office / LDCL, Kavaratti Office, by by post or in person, to reach by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for LDCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Pre Sea training with minimum 6 months sea service as Trainee Engine Rating onboard LDCL operated vessels; valid Indian CDC, Indian Passport, Engine Room Watch Keeping Certificate, STCW course certificates, Security Course and Passenger ship certificate (for passenger ships); all certificates updated as per DG Norms.

faq.question: Q4. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Valid Indian CDC and valid Indian Passport. Valid Engine Room Watch Keeping Certificate. Passenger ship certificate for working onboard passenger ships. All certificates should be updated as per DG Norms.
